site.subspace_fit_mask: Common nonzero-realized-XZ-motion rows for all three heads; metric fitted on all discovery rows

coordinate_frames.evaluation_target: Identical realized 3D world displacement and squared Euclidean world loss for every frame
coordinate_frames.goal_basis_definition: Columns: normalized current goal-minus-hand, normalized cross(world_up,goal_axis), cross(goal_axis,lateral)
coordinate_frames.goal_frame_availability: Requires current true hand/goal positions and world-up; cached simulator labels supply these. Runtime visual-only availability has not been established.
coordinate_frames.wall_frame_interpretation: A constant orthogonal target rotation is algebraically equivalent under isotropic ridge; it cannot identify a native coordinate frame.

camera_frame.reason: No camera extrinsic calibration in pooled cache

native_frame.reason: Decoding compares functional parameterizations; state-dependent goal basis uses extra geometry.

regime_subspaces.metric: Same fixed full-discovery mean/std as global subspace comparisons
regime_subspaces.interpretation: Descriptive conditional fits; unequal sample sizes, time, and trajectory occupancy confound comparison. No latent-state/HMM inference.

natural_support.distance: Euclidean distance / sqrt(channel_count), standardized with training-seed mean/std
natural_support.interpretation: Held-seed proximity to natural training activations; not a manifold proof or an assessment of edited states.

edited_state_distance.reason: No causal edited activations supplied to this cached-data analysis

eigenspectrum.interpretation: Actual activation covariance spectrum, not target code dimension or intervention rank

pca_trajectories.fit_scope: All 150 discovery episodes only; descriptive PCA, not held-out prediction
pca_trajectories.selection: Predetermined seed1 episodes0,1,2; no outcome selection

regime_dependence.time_confounding: Regimes have different time and trajectory composition; residual differences do not identify causal regimes or HMM states.
